plugins.name: mcptoon
plugins.description: MCP tool-catalog compression for Claude Code. Compresses the tool discovery payload from 71,929 to 581 tokens (-99.2%). Auto-installs the zero-dependency mcptoon CLI (/mcptoon-setup), wires the serve bridge, and teaches the agent when to compress. MCP 2026-07-28 stateless-first bridge included.
